sources.snippet: Overview SymbioticLM-8B is a state-of-the-art hybrid transformer model with built-in symbolic cognition. It combines an 8B Qwen-based transformer with modular symbolic processors and a persistent memory buffer. The model supports both general conversation and deep symbolic tasks such as theorem generation, logical chaining, and structured reasoning with retained memory across turns.
